title: The Name Said Clearly at the Gate
youtube_title: The Name Said Clearly at the Gate | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Speaking up once, softly, can open a door.
summary: At a music corner with a drum and a recorder, Isla feels shy about an own name, which felt shy in a new group. Instead of pretending not to care, Isla tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie Luz stays kind and does not push for a show.
